source: MAFF/JICA APPP (Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap) Farmer Field School Technical Manual for Extension Officers, December 2014 -- no elibrary URL visible on this scan.
province: Battambang, Pursat, Kampong Chhnang (APPP project area)
text: Rice fertilizer is normally applied in three rounds: a basal DAP application at land preparation or transplanting time, a first urea topdressing about 20-30 days after transplanting (or about 40-50 days after direct seeding), and a second urea topdressing timed to the panicle initiation stage (កំណរកំណើតគួរ) of the crop, roughly 70-85 days after sowing depending on variety. A commonly cited rate is roughly 40-50 kg/ha DAP as basal fertilizer and roughly 50 kg/ha urea for each of the two topdressings, though farmers should treat these as starting-point ranges rather than fixed recommendations since real needs vary with soil and variety. To time the second topdressing correctly, farmers can check for the start of panicle initiation directly in the field: select a healthy stem from a rice hill, cut it near the base, and carefully peel back the outer leaf sheaths layer by layer until a small, pale, cone-shaped growing point becomes visible inside near the stem base. Once this panicle-initiation point reaches roughly 0.5 cm in length, it is a reliable field sign that the plant has begun reproductive development and needs additional nitrogen to support grain formation -- this is the signal to apply the second topdressing. Applying nitrogen too early or too late relative to this stage can waste fertilizer or reduce grain fill, so checking a few representative hills across the field is worth the few minutes it takes.
caveat: Fertilizer rate figures (kg/ha) are illustrative training figures from a scanned table, not a precise recommendation for a specific field; actual rates should account for soil test results, variety, and local extension guidance. Duplicate-check recommended against existing urea top-dressing timing entries from prior batches -- the panicle-initiation field-check method itself may be the genuinely new element to add.
